visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoor sidewalk with traditional roofed fence. A man wearing sunglasses, a white T-shirt, and a beige overshirt stands facing the camera. He smiles and gestures with his hands in a playful, dismissive manner while looking at the person filming. (2) Inside a FamilyMart convenience store entrance. The man looks down at an umbrella rack, appearing frustrated and searching through items. He is wearing the same outfit. (3) Outside a building numbered 15. The man talks directly to the camera, then looks up and puts his hands on his hips in a gesture of dismay. (4) At a bank ATM. The man holds a smartphone, scans a QR code displayed on the screen, and then collects a stack of 100 TWD bills from the cash dispenser. (5) Outside the bank with green and yellow signage. The man stands close to the camera, holding up his smartphone to display an app interface while talking enthusiastically with varied hand gestures.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator, 1 female voice actor visible as a hand, 2 passers-by in the background of the bank scene.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An East Asian male in his late 20s or 30s with short dark hair, wearing sunglasses, a white t-shirt, a light beige button-up overshirt, and blue jeans.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Traditional Asian-style tiled walls on a sidewalk, the interior of a FamilyMart with umbrellas and glass doors, the stone exterior of a modern apartment or office building, and the green/yellow branded interior of a Cathay United Bank branch.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced electronic pop BGM begins. A female voice speaks with a high-pitched, teasing tone. A male voice responds with high arousal, laughing and shouting '沒有啦' (No way). (2) BGM cuts out abruptly. The male voice shifts to a frustrated, lower-pitched tone, complaining loudly about a missing umbrella. Faint indoor convenience store ambience is audible. (3) BGM resumes. Banter continues between male and female voices. The male voice displays high pitch variability when realizing he forgot his wallet. (4) A digital 'bing' SFX plays. The male voice adopts a more instructional, promotional tone, describing the CUBE app. The sound of an ATM mechanical latch and cash dispensing can be heard over the BGM. (5) BGM swells with a conclusive beat. The male voice continues enthusiastically with clear articulation, delivering a final marketing pitch with high vocal intensity.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook (POV Fears) -> Problem (Lost wallet) -> Solution (CUBE App Feature) -> Reward (Cashback/Promotion).
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'POV' style to highlight common everyday annoyances in Taiwan (excessive compliments, lost umbrellas, forgotten wallets) to naturally introduce the 'Mobile Withdrawal' feature of the Cathay United Bank CUBE App. It aims to drive app downloads and feature adoption by offering a financial reward (66 TWD) for first-time users.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the CUBE App interface, scanning a bank ATM, and explicit verbal/textual promotion of a 66 TWD incentive.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy editing style typical of social media creators (The DoDo Men), utilizing variety-show style text overlays to maintain engagement.
